A '''glooth''' was a type of mythical creature, 

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44BBY]], when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] encountered a [[Silan]] lair, Kenobi expressed a belief that they were mythical, like [[barracle]]s and glooths. However, his master confirmed that silans were real. It is not known if the legends of barracles and glooths were also based on fact.{{Creature-stub}}
